_readme: What the user is told changed. Policy and format: docs/tasks/whats-new.md. Add an entry in the same PR as the change; ids only go up and are never reused. 5 is skipped (a retired device test entry): the next id is 12.

entries.text: Marlow's routine jobs (the nightly ideas, tidying its memory, checking your inbox) now follow the day you set in Settings, under Your day. Check-ins can be turned off there.
Voice mode, where you talk to Marlow and hear its replies, now works in the Android app too.
You can take a photo from inside the app and send it to Marlow: tap + next to the message box and choose Take photo.
Marlow now tells you what changed after an update, like this. Past changes are always in Settings, under What's new.
You can now attach up to 6 photos to one message. Choose several at once from your library, or add them one at a time with the camera or paste.

Pairing a new device now uses a QR code or link instead of a six-digit code, and Unpair now also cuts that device off on Marlow's side, so a lost phone can be shut out. Devices you've already paired stay paired.

In the web app, Settings now has a Voice section: pick the voice voice mode reads replies in, and tap one to hear it first. These are the browser's own voices; the iPhone app keeps its own, better voices.

On an iPhone using the web app from the home screen, a reply you're watching no longer flashes a blank "Marlow has something for you." banner. If you lock the phone just before a reply lands, its notification can come up to about 15 seconds late.

Marlow's own files on the box (its memory, character, schedule and scripts) moved from the claude-assistant folder to marlow-identity, in the same home folder. Nothing in them changed and conversations carry on. If something of yours names the old folder, point it at the new one; the update lists any of Marlow's files that still do.

In the web app, voice mode now reads replies in Phonon, a natural voice made on your phone. The first time, it downloads the voice (about 65 MB) from Hugging Face; after that it works without downloading again. If you picked a voice in Settings, under Voice, choose Automatic to hear Phonon. You can also pick from 25 Phonon voices there; the default is Alfie.
